requirements.quote:
The "extension_data" field of this extension contains a
   "PreSharedKeyExtension" value:
requirements.condition: when encoding a pre_shared_key extension
requirements.required_behavior: encode a PreSharedKeyExtension value in extension_data
requirements.why_checkable: The extension payload can be parsed according to the declared type.

requirements.condition: when encoding PskIdentity.identity
requirements.required_behavior: encode identity as an opaque vector containing from 1 through 2^16-1 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty identity or an identity longer than 2^16-1 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The identity vector length prefix and payload length are directly parseable.

requirements.condition: when encoding PskIdentity.obfuscated_ticket_age
requirements.required_behavior: encode obfuscated_ticket_age as a uint32
requirements.why_checkable: The field has a fixed four-octet unsigned encoding.

requirements.quote: opaque PskBinderEntry<32..255>;
requirements.condition: when encoding a PskBinderEntry
requirements.required_behavior: encode it as an opaque vector containing from 32 through 255 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode a binder shorter than 32 octets or longer than 255 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The binder entry's vector length is directly parseable.

requirements.condition: when encoding OfferedPsks.identities
requirements.required_behavior: encode identities as a vector with encoded content length from 7 through 2^16-1 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode identities outside the declared vector bounds
requirements.why_checkable: The identities vector length prefix and content size are directly parseable.

requirements.condition: when encoding OfferedPsks.binders
requirements.required_behavior: encode binders as a vector with encoded content length from 33 through 2^16-1 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode binders outside the declared vector bounds
requirements.why_checkable: The binders vector length prefix and content size are directly parseable.

requirements.condition: when PreSharedKeyExtension occurs in ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: encode extension_data as OfferedPsks
requirements.why_checkable: The extension variant is selected by the containing handshake message type.

requirements.condition: when PreSharedKeyExtension occurs in ServerHello
requirements.required_behavior: encode extension_data as a uint16 selected_identity
requirements.why_checkable: The ServerHello variant has a fixed two-octet payload.

requirements.quote:
For identities
      established externally, an obfuscated_ticket_age of 0 SHOULD be
      used
requirements.condition: when offering an externally established PSK identity
requirements.required_behavior: set obfuscated_ticket_age to 0
requirements.why_checkable: The offered identity's four-octet age field can be compared with zero.

requirements.quote:
For identities
      established externally, an obfuscated_ticket_age of 0 SHOULD be
      used, and servers MUST ignore the value.
requirements.condition: when a server processes an externally established PSK identity
requirements.required_behavior: ignore obfuscated_ticket_age
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use obfuscated_ticket_age to accept, reject, or rank the external PSK
requirements.why_checkable: The external-PSK selection path can be checked for reads that influence behavior.

requirements.quote:
If sent alongside the "early_data"
      extension (see Section 4.2.10), the first identity is the one used
      for 0-RTT data.
requirements.condition: when pre_shared_key is sent alongside early_data
requirements.required_behavior: use the first identity for 0-RTT data
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a later identity for 0-RTT data
requirements.why_checkable: The early traffic key identity can be compared with identities index zero.

requirements.quote:
binders:  A series of HMAC values, one for each value in the
      identities list and in the same order, computed as described
      below.
requirements.condition: when computing an OfferedPsks binder entry
requirements.required_behavior: compute the entry as an HMAC value using the binder procedure
requirements.why_checkable: The entry can be recomputed with the specified HMAC binder procedure.

requirements.quote:
binders:  A series of HMAC values, one for each value in the
      identities list and in the same order, computed as described
      below.
requirements.condition: when encoding OfferedPsks.binders
requirements.required_behavior: include exactly one HMAC binder value for each identity
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode a binder count different from the identity count
requirements.why_checkable: The parsed binder and identity entry counts can be compared.

requirements.quote:
binders:  A series of HMAC values, one for each value in the
      identities list and in the same order, computed as described
      below.
requirements.condition: when encoding OfferedPsks.binders
requirements.required_behavior: place each binder in the same position as its corresponding identity
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reorder binders relative to their identities
requirements.why_checkable: Each binder can be recomputed from the PSK at the same list index.

requirements.quote:
selected_identity:  The server's chosen identity expressed as a
      (0-based) index into the identities in the client's list.
requirements.condition: when a server encodes selected_identity
requirements.required_behavior: encode the chosen identity as a zero-based index into the client's identities list
requirements.why_checkable: The selected value can be used directly as a zero-based list index.

requirements.quote: Each PSK is associated with a single Hash algorithm.
requirements.condition: when storing or using a PSK
requirements.required_behavior: associate the PSK with exactly one Hash algorithm
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treat the same PSK as associated with multiple Hash algorithms
requirements.why_checkable: PSK metadata and selection logic can be inspected for a single hash association.

requirements.quote:
For PSKs
   established via the ticket mechanism (Section 4.6.1), this is the KDF
   Hash algorithm on the connection where the ticket was established.
requirements.condition: when a PSK was established by the ticket mechanism
requirements.required_behavior: associate it with the KDF Hash algorithm from the connection where the ticket was established
requirements.why_checkable: Ticket PSK metadata can be compared with the originating connection's KDF hash.

requirements.quote:
For externally established PSKs, the Hash algorithm MUST be set when



Rescorla                     Standards Track                   [Page 56]

RFC 8446                           TLS                       August 2018


the PSK is established or default to SHA-256 if no such algorithm is
   defined.
requirements.condition: when an externally established PSK has a defined Hash algorithm
requirements.required_behavior: set the Hash algorithm when the PSK is established
requirements.why_checkable: External-PSK provisioning can be checked for persisted hash metadata.

requirements.quote:
For externally established PSKs, the Hash algorithm MUST be set when



Rescorla                     Standards Track                   [Page 56]

RFC 8446                           TLS                       August 2018


the PSK is established or default to SHA-256 if no such algorithm is
   defined.
requirements.condition: when no Hash algorithm is defined for an externally established PSK
requirements.required_behavior: default its Hash algorithm to SHA-256
requirements.why_checkable: The no-hash provisioning branch has a fixed default value.

requirements.quote:
The server MUST ensure that it selects a compatible PSK
   (if any) and cipher suite.
requirements.condition: when a server selects both a PSK and cipher suite
requirements.required_behavior: ensure that the PSK Hash algorithm is compatible with the cipher suite Hash algorithm
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select an incompatible PSK and cipher-suite combination
requirements.why_checkable: Both selections expose Hash algorithms that can be compared.

requirements.quote:
Clients, however, SHOULD
   store the SNI with the PSK to fulfill the requirements of
   Section 4.6.1.
requirements.condition: when a client stores a PSK associated with an SNI
requirements.required_behavior: store the SNI with the PSK
requirements.why_checkable: Client PSK persistence can be inspected for the associated SNI value.

requirements.quote:
Any unknown PSKs (e.g., ones
   not in the PSK database or encrypted with an unknown key) SHOULD
   simply be ignored.
requirements.condition: when a server encounters an unknown offered PSK
requirements.required_behavior: ignore the unknown PSK
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select the unknown PSK
requirements.why_checkable: Unknown database identities and undecryptable tickets have a defined skip path.

requirements.quote:
If no acceptable PSKs are found, the server
   SHOULD perform a non-PSK handshake if possible.
requirements.condition: when no offered PSK is acceptable and a non-PSK handshake is possible
requirements.required_behavior: perform a non-PSK handshake
requirements.why_checkable: The no-acceptable-PSK branch can be checked for fallback to certificate-based key establishment.

requirements.quote:
If backward
   compatibility is important, client-provided, externally established
   PSKs SHOULD influence cipher suite selection.
requirements.condition: when backward compatibility is configured as important and the client offers externally established PSKs
requirements.required_behavior: allow those PSKs' Hash algorithms to influence cipher suite selection
requirements.why_checkable: Cipher-suite ranking can be checked against the hashes of externally established PSKs under the stated policy.

requirements.quote:
Prior to accepting PSK key establishment, the server MUST validate
   the corresponding binder value (see Section 4.2.11.2 below).
requirements.condition: before a server accepts PSK key establishment
requirements.required_behavior: validate the binder corresponding to the selected PSK
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept PSK key establishment before validating the corresponding binder
requirements.why_checkable: Binder verification must dominate the acceptance state transition.

requirements.quote:
If this
   value is not present or does not validate, the server MUST abort the
   handshake.
requirements.condition: when the binder corresponding to the selected PSK is absent
requirements.required_behavior: abort the handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept or continue PSK key establishment
requirements.why_checkable: A missing selected binder has a mandatory termination outcome.

requirements.quote:
If this
   value is not present or does not validate, the server MUST abort the
   handshake.
requirements.condition: when the binder corresponding to the selected PSK fails validation
requirements.required_behavior: abort the handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept or continue PSK key establishment
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid selected binder has a mandatory termination outcome.

requirements.quote: Servers SHOULD NOT attempt to validate multiple binders;
requirements.condition: when a server evaluates offered PSKs
requirements.required_behavior: limit binder validation to the selected PSK
requirements.forbidden_behavior: attempt to validate multiple binders
requirements.why_checkable: Binder-verification invocations can be counted for a multi-identity offer.

requirements.quote:
rather, they SHOULD select a single PSK and validate solely the
   binder that corresponds to that PSK.
requirements.condition: when a server evaluates offered PSKs
requirements.required_behavior: select a single PSK before binder validation
requirements.why_checkable: The selection state can be checked before the binder-verification call.

requirements.quote:
rather, they SHOULD select a single PSK and validate solely the
   binder that corresponds to that PSK.
requirements.condition: when a server has selected one offered PSK
requirements.required_behavior: validate only the binder at the corresponding identity index
requirements.forbidden_behavior: validate a binder corresponding to a different PSK
requirements.why_checkable: The selected identity index and validated binder index can be compared.

requirements.quote:
In
   order to accept PSK key establishment, the server sends a
   "pre_shared_key" extension indicating the selected identity.
requirements.condition: when a server accepts PSK key establishment
requirements.required_behavior: send a pre_shared_key extension that indicates the selected identity
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept PSK key establishment without signaling the selected identity
requirements.why_checkable: The server acceptance state maps to a required ServerHello extension and value.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST verify that the server's selected_identity is within the
   range supplied by the client, that the server selected a cipher suite
   indicating a Hash associated with the PSK, and that a server
   "key_share" extension is present if required by the ClientHello
   "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension.  If these values are not
   consistent, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: when a client receives a server pre_shared_key selected_identity
requirements.required_behavior: verify that selected_identity is within the range of identities supplied by the client
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept an out-of-range selected_identity
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if the value is out of range
requirements.why_checkable: The selected uint16 value can be bounds-checked against the offered identity count.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST verify that the server's selected_identity is within the
   range supplied by the client, that the server selected a cipher suite
   indicating a Hash associated with the PSK, and that a server
   "key_share" extension is present if required by the ClientHello
   "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension.  If these values are not
   consistent, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: when a client receives a server-selected PSK and cipher suite
requirements.required_behavior: verify that the cipher suite indicates a Hash associated with the selected PSK
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept a cipher suite whose Hash is incompatible with the selected PSK
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if the Hash values are inconsistent
requirements.why_checkable: The cipher-suite Hash can be compared with the selected PSK's stored Hash.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST verify that the server's selected_identity is within the
   range supplied by the client, that the server selected a cipher suite
   indicating a Hash associated with the PSK, and that a server
   "key_share" extension is present if required by the ClientHello
   "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension.  If these values are not
   consistent, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: when the ClientHello psk_key_exchange_modes requires a server key_share
requirements.required_behavior: verify that the server key_share extension is present
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept the handshake without the required server key_share
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if key_share is absent
requirements.why_checkable: The advertised mode determines whether ServerHello key_share presence is mandatory.

requirements.quote:
If the server supplies an "early_data" extension, the client MUST
   verify that the server's selected_identity is 0.  If any other value
   is returned, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: when the server supplies an early_data extension
requirements.required_behavior: verify that selected_identity equals 0
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept early data with any other selected_identity
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if selected_identity is not 0
requirements.why_checkable: The server's early_data extension and selected_identity value are present in the same handshake.

requirements.quote:
The "pre_shared_key" extension MUST be the last extension in the
   ClientHello
requirements.condition: when a client includes pre_shared_key in ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: place pre_shared_key last in the ClientHello extension list
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place another extension after pre_shared_key
requirements.why_checkable: The order of the parsed ClientHello extension list is directly observable.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST check that it is the last extension and otherwise fail
   the handshake with an "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: when a server parses a ClientHello containing pre_shared_key
requirements.required_behavior: check that pre_shared_key is the last extension
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept a ClientHello with any extension after pre_shared_key
requirements.error_behavior: fail the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if pre_shared_key is not last
requirements.why_checkable: The parser can compare the extension's position with the end of the extension list and observe the alert.
